item.title: MongoDB Mastra Integration Adds Hybrid Search, Auto Embedding, and Reranking
item.description:
元記事公開：2026/11/24 9:00:00（日本時間）
Builders use Mastra, an open-source TypeScript framework, to create increasingly capable agents with MongoDB. But preparing retrieval for those agents can mean copying operational data into a separate collection, generating and syncing embeddings, merging semantic and keyword results, reranking, and fetching full records: a lot of code to maintain, and a lot of places for data to drift.

item.title: How to Align Modern Payment Platforms with PCI DSS Using MongoDB Enterprise Advanced
item.description:
元記事公開：2026/11/19 9:00:00（日本時間）
Payment platforms operate in a demanding environment. They must protect payment account data and support the teams that authorize transactions, investigate suspicious activity, and resolve exceptions. The more people and systems that can see sensitive data, the harder it is to control exposure. And the more data is locked away, the harder it can be to use in legitimate workflows. So how can you set up the platforms to ensure they protect that data while also giving the right people access?

item.title: Optimizing Document Lookup: Making Atlas Search and Vector Search Up to 5x Faster
item.description:
元記事公開：2026/11/11 9:00:00（日本時間）

That is exactly what we discovered while optimizing document lookup in MongoDB Atlas Search and Vector Search. By removing redundant query planning and execution overhead, we made search queries up to 5x faster without changing the underlying search algorithms.
